shots.title: 실내 전체 · 짧은 돌리 인
shots.camera_prompt: Begin with the established wide left-hand-drive cabin composition. Make a very short, slow physical dolly in toward the visible dashboard. No pullback, zoom out, widening field of view, newly revealed rear seats, additional roof structure or newly invented interior parts.
